summary.text: OSLOBOLIG AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2021-10-01. OSLOBOLIG AS invests in real estate, including property companies, property development, and other activities naturally connected to this. The company's statutory purpose is buying, selling and renting homes to scale its offering for home purchases in Oslo using different home-buying models. It was previously named NFH 211047 AS until 2021-12-03. Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 11 392 001 NOK and the annual result was 2 267 278 NOK; operating income was up from 9 910 051 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 1 408 962 NOK in 2024 to 2 267 278 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 84 738 909 NOK in 2024 to 87 006 187 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is oslobolig.no. The latest news on its own website is "Slik er hverdagen i en OsloBolig" from 2026-10-23. The register's most recent update was on 2026-06-22 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
